player_prompt.intro:
Mo kpɛlɛngɛ Countdown tɛnzɛnɛ lɛkɛ!
Gbɛlɛ: Kɛlɛngɛ nɔmbɛrɛ na +, -, *, / pɔrɔ fɔ tɔndɔ.
Kɛlɛngɛ format: [i j op] wɛlɛ i,j a nɔmbɛrɛ nɛnɛ nɛ op a kɛlɛngɛ.
Gbɛlɛ: [0 2 *] kɛlɛngɛ nɔmbɛrɛ na index 0 na nɔmbɛrɛ na index 2.
Kɛlɛngɛ tɛnzɛnɛ pɔrɔ fɔ tɔndɔ na nɔmbɛrɛ nzɛnzɛ pɛpɛ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kɛlɛngɛ format nzɛnzɛ. Fɔ [i j op] wɛlɛ i,j a nɔmbɛrɛ nɛnɛ nɛ op a +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: A lingbi a duti nde na yâ ti wungo 0-{max_index}
invalid_move.invalid_operation: A yeke na lege ni pëpe ti sara kua so (ti kangbi ye na zero wala mbeni wungo kue ape)

outcome.win: Aye so ala yeke gi ayeke tâ nzoni mingi. {target}
outcome.turn_limit: Ködörö tî kpa ti ngû. Ködörö ngä ti mbï: {best_value} (sêse: {target})
